status: registered before any GSE263012 file was downloaded or opened by this program
origin: wide-screen pair gc ~ dlam_mCh (GSE300197 acute siLMNA, iPSC): confirmed on held-out even autosomes (rho -0.236) and survived the exploratory independent-baseline control (rho -0.242 / -0.248)
hypothesis: after loss of lamin A/C, the change in lamin B1 contact is negatively related to GC content beyond baseline lamina contact and gene density: GC-rich regions lose lamina contact relative to AT-rich regions
cohort: GSE263012, K562, LMNB1 pA-DamID log2(LMNB1 / Dam control) bigWigs at 25 kb, hg38 (per GEO; verified at run time: chr1 length must equal 248956422)
batches: file names are K562_r{batch}_{clone}: WT is parental clone 17 (batches r1, r2, r8), LMNA KO is clone 14 (batches r7, r8); r8 holds WT_r3, LMNAKO_r2, LBRKO_r3 and DKO_r2; both placebos are cross-batch and calibrate cross-batch GC bias; no within-batch WT placebo exists
tiling: hg38 500 kb tiles of features/tiles.tsv (autosomes); value = pyBigWig exact mean; NaN if exact coverage < 50%

primary_contrasts.P_batch: delta = LMNAKO_r2 - WT_r3 (same batch r8); covariates tss_count and mean(WT_r1, WT_r2) as independent baseline
primary_contrasts.P_all: delta = mean(LMNAKO_r1, LMNAKO_r2) - mean(WT_r1, WT_r2); covariates tss_count and WT_r3 as independent baseline

placebos.PL_within: delta = WT_r1 - WT_r2; covariates tss_count and WT_r3
placebos.PL_cross: delta = WT_r3 - WT_r1; covariates tss_count and WT_r2

secondary_reported_only.LBR_batch: delta = LBRKO_r3 - WT_r3; covariates tss_count and mean(WT_r1, WT_r2)
secondary_reported_only.DKO_batch: delta = DKO_r2 - WT_r3; covariates tss_count and mean(WT_r1, WT_r2)

statistic: rank-partial Spearman via code/screen.py test_pair, all autosomes, within-chromosome circular shift of gc (min shift 10 tiles), 5000 shifts, seed 20261010 + index in the order P_batch, P_all, PL_within, PL_cross, LBR_batch, DKO_batch
abort_rule: any test with n < 3000 or non-finite rho, or a chr1 length mismatch, aborts with no label

labels.REPLICATED: both primaries rho <= -0.05 with one-sided negative p <= 0.01, and both placebos |rho| < 0.5 * mean |primary rho|
labels.DIRECTION_ONLY: both primaries pass but a placebo fails the size bound
labels.OPPOSITE: both primaries rho >= +0.05 with positive p <= 0.01
labels.final_rule: the reported label is REPLICATED only if both the raw and the scale-free arms are REPLICATED; if raw is REPLICATED and scale-free is not, the label is NOT_ROBUST_TO_SCALE (reported as not replicated); otherwise the raw label, with the scale-free label reported beside it

no_spin: any label other than REPLICATED is reported as not replicated in the first sentence
disclosed_limits: different cell type (K562 leukaemia vs iPSC), chronic knockout vs acute siRNA, pA-DamID vs the GSE300197 assay; both LMNA KO replicates come from one KO clone (14) against one WT clone (17), so clonal drift cannot be separated from lamin A/C loss; GC-dependent bias between batches is addressed by the batch-matched primary and two cross-batch placebos; copy number largely cancels in log2(target/Dam control) from the same cells
claim_ceiling: REPLICATED supports a cross-cohort, cross-assay association between GC content and lamina-contact change after lamin A/C loss, with a single KO clone; mechanism is not addressed; prior-art check follows
scale_free_arm: every test is also run after z-scoring each tile track genome-wide (autosomal tiles, mean 0, SD 1) before differencing and averaging; seeds +100; guards against a KO-vs-WT dynamic-range difference, which would put (b-1) x true lamina into the delta and let GC predict it in the registered direction
diagnostics_reported: per delta: OLS slope on its independent baseline; per track: autosomal SD; Spearman between replicate tracks
amendments: pre-freeze review design/damid-review.json PASS_WITH_REPAIRS: batch description corrected, scale-free arm and diagnostics added, single-clone limit disclosed, freeze binds code
